description: FREE — no payment or wallet: Free preflight on a URL before any paid readfetch_* call: HTTP status, content type, byte size, title, language, and whether a bot wall is waiting (`challenge`). When the response is HTML and not a challenge page, the JSON includes **`preview`**: the text readfetch_text would return (same extractor), up to **32,000 characters** for the first **3 probes per IP per day**, then **400 characters**. Use readfetch_probe instead of readfetch_text when choosing a route or estimating size; if `challenge: true`, use readfetch_scrape (then readfetch_residential if still blocked), not readfetch_text. Plain HTTP only — no browser render.

accept_language.description: Accept-Language header, e.g. 'de-DE,de;q=0.9'. Defaults to en-US.

timeout_s.description: Total budget for the whole call in seconds (default 10, max 60). Shared across redirects; does not apply to paid readfetch_text timeout_s on a follow-up call.

name: readfetch_probe
